verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a Perplexity API with an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, a published OpenAPI spec, a `pplx` CLI and MCP servers, but nothing names an official Perplexity SDK (e.g., Python or TypeScript client libraries). An OpenAI-compatible endpoint and an OpenAPI spec are building blocks for using third-party or generated clients, and the CLI and MCP servers belong to other stories, so none of them credits this one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
